name: Daytime Ground - Perseverance
description:
'The view of the Hymnoi land's not too bad from here. If you're not Infected, use your free time on your last day to climb the mountain and take in the sight of everything. Just imagine.'
<Originium Ice Crystal>Periodically releases a frigid wave that will inflict Cold on affected allied units
<Roadblock>Deploy to block the enemy's route

Garrison Effect: <Hymnoi Warrior> will proceed to the Twilight Frontier
